say:5:1028213003:1.text: We just happened to be passing by and saw you being chased by the wind elemental.
say:5:1028213003:1.source_cn: 咳，我们刚好路过，看到你在被风元素追赶……

say:6:1028213004:1.text: I-I was speaking with the wind! It's just that... our talk didn't go well. Anyway, thank you.
say:6:1028213004:1.source_cn: ……我、我是在和风沟通！只是没沟通好而已……我，嗯……...

say:7:1028213005:1.text: It's very late and very dangerous for you to be out alone. Let's get you somewhere safe. Maybe back to the academy?
say:7:1028213005:1.source_cn: 这么晚了，你一个人在外面多危险呀，我们先送你回安全的地...

say:8:1028213006:1.text: I can't leave! If I give up now, Misarte will think I'm not strong enough and take back the gift she's given me!
say:8:1028213006:1.source_cn: 不行！中途而废，弥萨忒一定会觉得我意志不够坚定，然后就...

say:9:1028213007:1.text: In case you don't know, I prayed to Misarte, and my prayers were answered!
say:9:1028213007:1.source_cn: 你们不知道，我向弥萨忒祈愿，得到了回应！

say:10:1028213008:1.text: But she is testing me. She wants me to discover my talent... Now it seems that whatever it is, it's definitely not windwhispering.
say:10:1028213008:1.source_cn: 但是，弥萨忒要考验我，需要让我自己找到天赋所在……现在...

say:11:1028213009:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as a magister, you must have a lot of knowledge. How do I recognize the talent I've been blessed with?
say:11:1028213009:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as a magister, you must have a lot of knowledge. How do I recognize the talent I've been blessed with?
say:11:1028213009:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as a magister, you must have a lot of knowledge. How do I recognize the talent I've been blessed with?

choice_prompt:12:1028213009.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，您是位魔法师，一定懂得很多……请问，我要怎样才能找到神赐予我的天赋？

say:13:1028213010:1.text: Within...? Are you saying I should look into my heart and pray to Misarte even more?
say:13:1028213010:1.source_cn: 内心？您是说我应该更虔诚地、全心全意向弥萨忒祈愿？
say:13:1028213010:1.male: Within...? Are you saying I should look into my heart and pray to Misarte even more?
say:13:1028213010:1.female: Within...? Are you saying I should look into my heart and pray to Misarte even more?

say:14:1028213011:1.text: Oh... You are truly pure of heart...

say:15:1028213013:1.text: Okay... I need to do another ritual and ask for Misarte's guidance again!
say:15:1028213013:1.source_cn: 嗯，没错……我要布置仪式，再次请求弥萨忒的指引！

say:17:1028213012:1.text: You're right. Maybe I got too excited last time and misunderstood Misarte's blessing.
say:17:1028213012:1.source_cn: 嗯，您说得对，或许上次我太兴奋， 忽略了弥萨忒给予的启示。
